description: Manages comment threads via the Drive API. action=create adds a NEW comment (needs content; optional quoted_text cites a passage — the API cannot anchor a new comment to a live range, that anchor format is not public, so it appears at document level). action=reply adds a reply (needs comment_id + content). action=resolve closes the thread (needs comment_id; optional content posts a closing reply); action=reopen reactivates it. action=delete PERMANENTLY removes the comment and all its replies (needs comment_id) — deleting is final, resolving is the reversible way to close a thread. Get comment_id from list_comments. Requires a Drive scope on the OAuth token.

action.description: What to do with the document's comments.

comment_id.description: reply/resolve/reopen/delete: the comment thread to target (from list_comments).

content.description: create/reply: the comment text (plain text). Optional closing text for resolve/reopen.

document_id.description: The document id — the long id from the document URL (docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit) or from create_document output.

quoted_text.description: create only: the passage of document text the comment refers to (shown as a quote).

name: manage_comment
title: Create, reply to, resolve or delete a comment
